# Prompt: Functional Requirement to UX Spec

## Objective
Translate functional requirements into complete UX/UI specs.

## Prompt
```text
@functional-to-ux-spec interpreta este requerimiento funcional y genera spec UX completa:
- Intencion
- Flujo
- Arquitectura de informacion
- Wireframe descriptivo
- Microcopy
- Estados
- Accesibilidad
- Criterios de aceptacion
- Metrica/hipotesis
```

## Expected Output
- Structured spec with explicit assumptions.
- Testable acceptance criteria.
- Recovery paths and accessibility requirements.
